rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when interpreting or explaining something with reference to its context.

example.english: The word can have different meanings contextually.
example.traditional: 按語境，呢個字可以有唔同解法。
example.jyutping: on3 jyu5 ging2 ni1 go3 zi6 ho2 ji5 jau5 m4 tung4 gaai2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the meaning or answer depends on the context.

example.english: The answer has to be interpreted contextually because it depends on the situation.
example.traditional: 呢個答案視乎語境先可以決定。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 daap3 on3 si6 fu4 jyu5 ging2 sin1 ho2 ji5 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this for the more literal sense of considering something within its surrounding linguistic or situational context.

example.english: In context, this word does not have that meaning and must be read contextually.
example.traditional: 喺語境入面，呢個字唔係解嗰個意思。
example.jyutping: hai2 jyu5 ging2 jap6 min6 ni1 go3 zi6 m4 hai6 gaai2 go2 go3 ji3 si1
